acceptanceCriteria.text: Canonical Runtime Appliance reconciliation can create/update/remove only the managed-runtime GC roots required by its lifecycle.
Generation A remains realized and executable after activation followed by real Nix GC.
After activating generation B, retained active/previous generations survive real Nix GC according to lifecycle policy.
Rollback/recovery to the retained previous generation succeeds after GC.
`managedRuntimeReady` rejects dangling or missing retained targets and missing required executables.
Tests run under the canonical appliance/service-user authority rather than only a host filesystem fixture.

issue.title: fix(runtime): provision managed-generation GC-root authority in the canonical appliance
